fullDesc: On August 15, 2021 the Taliban entered Kabul as the Afghan government collapsed, days before the planned end of the US withdrawal. A chaotic airlift evacuated over 120,000 people.
realFacts: A suicide bombing killed 13 US troops and many Afghans on August 26
The Afghan army collapsed within weeks
The Taliban restricted women's education
Western nations froze Afghan funds

title: The Tokyo Olympics Are Held Without Spectators
shortDesc: The Games are delayed a year by COVID and played in empty stadiums.
fullDesc: The Tokyo Olympics, postponed from 2020 because of COVID-19, were held from July to August 2021, mostly without spectators. They were the first Games ever delayed in peacetime.
realFacts: Skateboarding and surfing made their debut
Simone Biles stepped back from several events
The US topped the medal table narrowly over China
The cost was well above the original budget

title: Gaza War Begins After October 7 Attack
shortDesc: A Hamas attack on Israel starts a devastating war.
fullDesc: On October 7, 2023 Hamas fighters attacked Israel, killing about 1,200 people and taking about 250 hostages. Israel responded with a major military campaign in Gaza that caused widespread destruction and a humanitarian crisis.
realFacts: It was the deadliest day for Jews since the Holocaust
Tens of thousands of Palestinians have died
A ceasefire in 2025 allowed some hostages to be freed
The conflict spread to Lebanon and Iran

title: The Turkey-Syria Earthquakes
shortDesc: Two powerful quakes kill more than 50,000 people.
fullDesc: On February 6, 2023 two earthquakes of magnitude 7.8 and 7.5 struck southern Turkey and northern Syria, killing more than 50,000 people. Thousands of buildings collapsed, and many that failed had ignored building codes.
realFacts: Millions were left homeless
It was among the deadliest quakes in the 21st century
Rescuers from dozens of countries helped
Turkey later arrested builders over unsafe construction

title: The Paris Olympics Opening on the Seine
shortDesc: The Games open with a boat parade through the city.
fullDesc: The 2024 Paris Olympics opened on July 26 with athletes sailing down the Seine rather than in a stadium. The Games featured star performances by Léon Marchand and Simone Biles and ended with Los Angeles taking up the next Games.
realFacts: Marchand won four golds in swimming
The US and China tied on golds at 40
Breaking made its Olympic debut
Los Angeles hosts in 2028
